isolation.method: Docker (linux/amd64 server 29.7.2) containers on WSL2; hard cgroup v2 limits
isolation.swap_policy: memory.swap.max=0 inside every test container (no swap spill possible); WSL2 VM reports SwapTotal 3145728 kB but cgroup swap is disabled by memory-swap==memory

host.cpu: Intel64 Family 6 Model 186 Stepping 2 (i7-13620H, 6P+4E), 16 logical CPUs, AVX2/FMA3, no AVX-512

container_runtime_seen_by_benchmark.note: intra_op threads stay at the frozen production value 6 in ALL profiles; the CPU QUOTA (not thread count) enforces 1.0/0.5 vCPU

image.contents: frozen engine subset + FastAPI service + pinned runtime deps + baked model/voices/frontend data; NO torch, NO whisper/DNSMOS/ASR, NO training stack

ambient_conditions.note: User production services were left untouched; they contribute ambient load on the host but cannot violate the tested container's own cgroup quotas.
